findings.text: The issue requires this and the change does not meet it: RQLAB-2: The test file retains the stale test "claimed label contains 'claimed:' prefix" that asserts the OLD `claimed:<machine>` label format. Because the new code correctly writes `zbuild:claimed` (not `claimed:<machine>`), the substring `claimed:` does not appear in `zbuild:claimed`, so this stale assertion fires as a failure, causing the test suite to fail. — plugins/claim-coordinator/github-labels/tests/claim-coordinator-unit-test.sh | assert_fail "claimed label contains 'claimed:' prefix" "$(cat "$labels_file" 2>/dev/null || echo '<empty>')" — ACCEPTED IF: There is no machine name in the label
